title: What Causes Lightning?
speaker: NOAA SciJinks
zh: 【NOAA SciJinks】閃電產生的原因是什麼？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: What Causes Lightning?
cues.en: What Causes Lightning?
cues.zh: 閃電產生的原因是什麼？

cues.text: Lightning can be a beautiful—and scary—part of Earth’s weather.
cues.en: Lightning can be a beautiful—and scary—part of Earth’s weather.
cues.zh: 閃電是地球天氣中美麗又可怕的一部分。

cues.text: You probably have seen lightning in a thunderstorm, but do you know why lightning happens?
cues.en: You probably have seen lightning in a thunderstorm, but do you know why lightning happens?
cues.zh: 你可能在雷暴雨中見過閃電，但你知道為什麼會發生閃電嗎？

cues.text: Lightning comes from electrical charges that build up within a storm cloud.
cues.en: Lightning comes from electrical charges that build up within a storm cloud.
cues.zh: 閃電來自暴風雨雲中積聚的電荷。

cues.text: Thunderstorms form when warm, moist air rises high into the atmosphere.
cues.en: Thunderstorms form when warm, moist air rises high into the atmosphere.
cues.zh: 當溫暖潮濕的空氣上升到大氣中時，雷暴就會形成。

cues.text: This rising air is called an updraft.
cues.en: This rising air is called an updraft.
cues.zh: 這種上升的空氣稱為上升氣流。

cues.text: As air rises in the atmosphere, clouds form when water vapor in the air cools into water
cues.en: As air rises in the atmosphere, clouds form when water vapor in the air cools into water
cues.zh: 當空氣在大氣中上升時，空氣中的水蒸氣冷卻成水就會形成雲

cues.text: drops, called cloud droplets.
cues.en: drops, called cloud droplets.
cues.zh: 水滴，稱為雲滴。

cues.text: Some cloud droplets freeze into ice crystals.
cues.en: Some cloud droplets freeze into ice crystals.
cues.zh: 有些雲滴凍結成冰晶。

cues.text: These cloud droplets and ice crystals collide and form larger particles, called graupel.
cues.en: These cloud droplets and ice crystals collide and form larger particles, called graupel.
cues.zh: 這些雲滴和冰晶碰撞並形成更大的顆粒，稱為霰。

cues.text: As the ice crystals rise up, they collide with the larger and heavier graupel.
cues.en: As the ice crystals rise up, they collide with the larger and heavier graupel.
cues.zh: 當冰晶上升時，它們與更大、更重的霰粒碰撞。

cues.text: These collisions result in positively and negatively charged particles.
cues.en: These collisions result in positively and negatively charged particles.
cues.zh: 這些碰撞產生帶正電和帶負電的粒子。

cues.text: Ice crystals are small and light.
cues.en: Ice crystals are small and light.
cues.zh: 冰晶小而輕。

cues.text: The updraft carries the positively charged ice crystals higher and higher into the cloud.
cues.en: The updraft carries the positively charged ice crystals higher and higher into the cloud.
cues.zh: 上升氣流將帶正電的冰晶帶到雲中越來越高的位置。

cues.text: The thunderstorm cloud is mostly negatively charged, which causes a mostly positive charge
cues.en: The thunderstorm cloud is mostly negatively charged, which causes a mostly positive charge
cues.zh: 雷暴雲大部分帶負電，這會導致大部分帶正電

cues.text: to form on the ground.
cues.en: to form on the ground.
cues.zh: 在地面上形成。

cues.text: When these opposite charges become strong enough, there is an electrical discharge—an
cues.en: When these opposite charges become strong enough, there is an electrical discharge—an
cues.zh: 當這些相反的電荷變得足夠強時，就會發生放電——

cues.text: energy release—in the form of lightning.
cues.en: energy release—in the form of lightning.
cues.zh: 能量釋放－以閃電的形式。

cues.text: Lightning often connects the negative charges in the cloud to positive charges on the ground.
cues.en: Lightning often connects the negative charges in the cloud to positive charges on the ground.
cues.zh: 閃電經常將雲中的負電荷與地面上的正電荷連線起來。

cues.text: This is called cloud-to-ground lightning.
cues.en: This is called cloud-to-ground lightning.
cues.zh: 這稱為雲對地閃電。

cues.text: Why does lightning often hit trees, telephone poles, or other tall structures first?
cues.en: Why does lightning often hit trees, telephone poles, or other tall structures first?
cues.zh: 為什麼閃電經常先擊中樹木、電線桿或其他高層建築？

cues.text: Trees and telephone poles are often the tallest objects on the ground.
cues.en: Trees and telephone poles are often the tallest objects on the ground.
cues.zh: 樹木和電線桿通常是地面上最高的物體。

cues.text: So, they are closest to the storm cloud and the first thing in the path of lightning.
cues.en: So, they are closest to the storm cloud and the first thing in the path of lightning.
cues.zh: 因此，它們距離風暴雲最近，也是閃電路徑上的第一個東西。

cues.text: Lightning can also stay within a cloud or even travel between two clouds.
cues.en: Lightning can also stay within a cloud or even travel between two clouds.
cues.zh: 閃電也可以停留在雲層內，甚至可以在兩層雲層之間傳播。

cues.text: This happens when lightning travels from a negative charge in one cloud to a positive
cues.en: This happens when lightning travels from a negative charge in one cloud to a positive
cues.zh: 當閃電從一朵雲中的負電荷傳播到正電荷時，就會發生這種情況

cues.text: charge within another cloud.
cues.en: charge within another cloud.
cues.zh: 在另一個雲中充電。

cues.text: This is known as intra-cloud lightning.
cues.en: This is known as intra-cloud lightning.
cues.zh: 這被稱為雲內閃電。

cues.text: By the time you see lightning in the sky, a storm is probably already underway in your
cues.en: By the time you see lightning in the sky, a storm is probably already underway in your
cues.zh: 當你看到天空中的閃電時，風暴可能已經在你的身邊發生了。

cues.text: neighborhood.
cues.en: neighborhood.
cues.zh: 鄰裡。

cues.text: But tracking lightning from space can help meteorologists predict the intensity of a
cues.en: But tracking lightning from space can help meteorologists predict the intensity of a
cues.zh: 但是從太空追蹤閃電可以幫助氣象學家預測閃電的強度

cues.text: storm.
cues.en: storm.
cues.zh: 風暴。

cues.text: NOAA’s GOES-R series weather satellites captured this imagery of lightning during
cues.en: NOAA’s GOES-R series weather satellites captured this imagery of lightning during
cues.zh: NOAA 的 GOES-R 系列氣象衛星在

cues.text: a series of thunderstorms over the Midwestern United States.
cues.en: a series of thunderstorms over the Midwestern United States.
cues.zh: 美國中西部上空發生一系列雷暴。

cues.text: Imagery and information from these satellites help forecasters to predict the intensity
cues.en: Imagery and information from these satellites help forecasters to predict the intensity
cues.zh: 來自這些衛星的影象和資訊幫助預報員預測強度

cues.text: of a storm and whether or not the storm will produce high winds or tornadoes.
cues.en: of a storm and whether or not the storm will produce high winds or tornadoes.
cues.zh: 風暴的發生以及風暴是否會產生強風或龍捲風。

cues.text: Find out more about Earth’s weather at NOAA SciJinks!
cues.en: Find out more about Earth’s weather at NOAA SciJinks!
cues.zh: 在 NOAA SciJinks 中瞭解更多有關地球天氣的資訊！
